concepts.title: Brand bookends
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop website component concept, created with ImageGen for visual exploration only.
Input image roles: Image 1 is the earlier common desktop frame, a style reference and redesign target. Image 2 is the ORIGINAL Software logo to preserve. Image 3 is the ORIGINAL Consulting logo to preserve. Redesign the layout specified below; do not reproduce the previous four-column footer or previous navigation by default.
Brand constraints: Same reusable frame for Software, Open Source, Skills and Consulting; same positions and typography on every site, with only an active marker changing. Original Software teal and Consulting berry marks have EQUAL visual rank. Open Source and Skills belong to Software; do not invent their own logos. Precisely preserve the original flower emblems and original wordmark letterforms from images 2 and 3. Use small brand marks at plausible UI scale. Extract the logo artwork visually onto neutral paper, rather than placing the colored rectangular reference-image backgrounds into the layout.
Visual language: magazine-like editorial layout with a clear alignment grid, generous vertical whitespace and very light paper grain, near-white neutral background and graphite ink. Original Software teal and Consulting berry are restrained accents. Regular/book-weight serif headings with comfortable leading; navigation and smaller text in a refined legible sans serif. No oversized hero type, no bold serif display, no heavy full-width dark blocks, no beige wash, no pink page tint, no repetitive skewing, no exaggerated pill buttons, no browser chrome, no stock browser mockups, no hero photographs, no fake placeholder prose. All labels accurately spelled. One concept only; no collage, alternatives, explanation panels, arrows, dimensions or board title drawn into the image.
Header-only composition: A wide landscape desktop viewport excerpt, ideally 1600 x 640. Put the ONE header at the very top, spanning the viewport or inset only as the variant specifies. Its physical target is a SINGLE COMPACT 48 CSS-pixel row at a 1440px desktop viewport, never a tall masthead, never two stacked navigation rows. All symbols fit at roughly 22px high and wordmarks at roughly 20-24px high. Use readable roughly 14-15px navigation type, no 64px or 96px navigation. Leave a small neutral Software page excerpt below only for scale and continuity: ample top margin then a modest regular-serif heading, "Independent software.", and one sans-serif line, "Products, open source and technical consulting." No footer, no second header, no newsletter. Language control "EN / DE". Active state shown for Software. The context heading should be less important than the navigation and no larger than about 40 CSS pixels.
Layout idea H01: BRANDS AT OPPOSITE ENDS, TWO ASSOCIATED LINK CLUSTERS. Left cluster is the complete original Software wordmark, followed by "Products", "Open Source", "Skills". Right cluster is the complete original Consulting wordmark, followed by "Services", "Profiles", and "EN / DE" at the outer right. The gap between the two clusters provides flexibility and breathing room. Both wordmarks have the same rendered height and optical weight. The original logos themselves link to each brand homepage; do not add redundant Software or Consulting text labels. One tiny teal underline under the Software wordmark indicates active site. Flat neutral paper, open geometry, a single almost invisible lower hairline. This is a restrained editorial two-brand masthead in a truly compact row.
